rationale: C14 plausibly supplied a material drafting template because it is likewise a presidential letter directing housing officials about quantified mortgage authority and Federal National Mortgage Association operations. Both texts combine an aggregate monetary authorization with instructions governing FNMA mortgage purchases, although the child adapts the machinery from restricting purchases to financing special assistance for elderly housing. C23 shares housing-mortgage authorization machinery but lacks the funding-and-purchase structure; C03 shares an aggregate $20 million authorization but concerns unrelated shipping advances.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the aggregate amount of such purchases and commitments pursuant to this authorization ... shall not exceed $20,000,000
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the aggregate outstanding amount of mortgages which may be insured under Title II ... [is] increased by ... $650 million
shared_material.explanation: Both letters establish or enlarge quantified presidential authority concerning federally supported mortgages.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby increase the funds released in my earlier letters from $160,000,000 to $180,000,000 for purchase and commitments
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby approve an increase of $650 million in the aggregate outstanding amount of mortgages which may be insured
shared_material.explanation: The child closely follows the parent’s authorization-by-letter structure: identify an existing aggregate mortgage limit and expressly increase it by a stated amount.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Federal National Mortgage Association shall minimize its expenditures through the use of commitments to purchase immediate participations in mortgages whenever practicable rather than through purchases of 100 percent interests
shared_material.parent_excerpt: reexamine immediately the regulations of the Federal National Mortgage Association governing both the purchase and sale of insured and guaranteed mortgages ... further mortgage purchases are held to the irreducible minimum
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude with operational instructions controlling how FNMA should conduct mortgage purchases and minimize federal exposure.
